title: Section 770.2 - Revise the definition of “Abandoned Optical Fiber Cable” in Section 770.2 to read as follows:
officialText:
Abandoned Optical Fiber Cable. Installed optical fiber cable that is not terminated at equipment other than a
connector and not identified for future use with a tag securely fixed to each end and indicating the location of the
opposing end.
